description: Work with your MOCO agency account: log, list and change time entries, manage projects and their tasks, customers and contacts, and list invoices. Start workflows on new time entries, projects, companies and invoices.

moco_new_activity_trigger.description: Runs for each new time entry you can see in MOCO, with its day, hours, description, project, task, customer and person. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.billable: Whether the time can be billed.
output.customer: The customer: its id and name.
output.date: The day the work was done, as YYYY-MM-DD.
output.description: What the time was spent on.
output.id: The time entry's ID, for Update or Delete time entry.
output.project: The project: its id, identifier and name.
output.tag: The entry's own label, if any.
output.task: The task: its id and name.
output.user: Who logged it: their id, firstname and lastname.

parameters.description: Only run for time logged on this project, by its id from List projects. Leave empty for every project.
parameters.name: project_id

moco_new_company_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer, supplier or organization in MOCO, with its contact details. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The company's ID, for Update or Delete company.
output.name: The company's name.

moco_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs for each new invoice in MOCO, with its number, title, customer, totals, dates and status. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.due_date: When payment is due, as YYYY-MM-DD.
output.project_id: The project's ID, if it is for one.
output.status: Its status, such as draft, created or sent.
output.title: The invoice's title.

moco_new_project_trigger.description: Runs for each new project in MOCO, with its number, name, customer, leader, dates, budget and tasks. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.currency: The currency it is billed in, such as EUR.
output.customer: The customer: its id and name.
output.fixed_price: Whether it has a fixed price.
output.id: The project's ID, for Get, Update or Delete project.
output.identifier: The project's number, such as P-123.
output.leader: The project leader: their id, firstname and lastname.
output.name: The project's name.
